summary: The PR addresses the issue of ignoring the dash offset in patch objects by removing the code that sets the dash pattern to always start at 0. The provided reproduction and edge case tests demonstrate the fix.

issues.description: The change may introduce behavioral regression risk as it alters how dash patterns are handled for patches, which could affect other use cases not covered by the current tests.
The new test files and script do not follow the typical structure of the existing test suite, which might be considered a minor style inconsistency.
